description: This is a pie chart. The pie chart is titled "The distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs, over the WildChat conversations that are matched to online articles from the two identified news agencies." The pie chart is divided into six slices, each representing a different type of input stimulus material. The largest slice, representing 18.7%, is for "Press Release," followed by "Draft/Other" at 26.4%, "Email" at 2.7%, "Event Posting" at 6.6%, "Organizational Website" at 4.9%, "Organizational Report" at 7.7%, and "Social Media Post" at 1.1%. The pie chart does not include a legend, and there are no percentage labels inside the slices. The colors of the slices are not distinguishable in the description.
